referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of an average inverter ( 5 kW) for photovoltaic plant. Total weight about 18.0 kg. The printed wiring board weighs 0.5 kg and the printed wiring board assembly (total) 2.0 kg. Average calculated with data from three leading European manufacturers and extrapolated to the power scale of interest.; UUID: 9458681a-306b-37b8-b1bf-db7b95b0e1a8
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Materials, packaging and electricity use for the production of an average inverter. Disposal of the product after use (metals and the printed wiring board are assumed to be recycled).
referenceFunction.name: Inverter, 5 kW, average, at plant

technology.text: Inverter for a photovoltaic grid-connected system with a capacity of 5kWp.

representativeness.extrapolations: Data for inverters of different output power converted to a common output of 10kW using a power law. Extrapolation to 5kW with the same function.
